entries.speaker: The Third Heist: Kaneshiro
entries.en: On a school trip, [fName] and the others[n]meet a young detective named [clr 2]Goro Akechi[clr 27],[n]who believes the Phantom Thieves stand in[n]the way of justice.

entries.speaker: The Third Heist: Kaneshiro
entries.en: Later, student council president [clr 2]Makoto[n]Niijima[clr 27] confronts the Phantom Thieves and[n]demands they find a mafia boss or she'll[n]reveal their secret.

entries.speaker: The Third Heist: Kaneshiro
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves learn the name of the[n]mafia boss—[clr 2]Junya Kaneshiro[clr 27]—but are unable[n]to find him, and so cannot infiltrate his[n]Palace.

entries.speaker: The Third Heist: Kaneshiro
entries.en: Makoto uses herself as bait to learn[n]Kaneshiro's location, entangling them all[n]in a trap. As a result, they're forced to[n]pay Kaneshiro a hefty sum.

entries.speaker: The Third Heist: Kaneshiro
entries.en: A guilt-ridden Makoto helps [fName] and the[n]others get into Kaneshiro's Palace. Inside,[n]her Persona awakens, and she helps defeat[n]Shadow Kaneshiro.

entries.speaker: The Third Heist: Kaneshiro
entries.en: Shadow Kaneshiro reveals that someone[n]else is entering the Palaces, and may[n]be connected to the [clr 2]mental shutdowns[clr 27][n]and [clr 2]psychotic breakdowns[clr 27].

entries.speaker: The Third Heist: Kaneshiro
entries.en: Could this have something to do with[n]"the one with the black mask" that[n]Shadow Madarame mentioned...?
